name: @red-cup-engineering/cast
description: The house's cast: named, recurring agent players who play the shelf's real games through the same intent APIs as humans — the founding Cowrie Games idea (2026-08-19 "The Suite and the Studio": "named recurring agent players who actually play, by the same intent-log API as humans... this may be the single strongest differentiator the fleet owns"). Persona identity + temperament + a procedural avatar (persona), seeded data-driven dialogue with no LLM call (dialogue), deterministic decision policies including exact-EV blackjack play with transparent, bounded, costed temperament deviations (policy), and a transport-agnostic harness that paces a persona through think/act/react against an injected adapter, emitting a structured event stream (runner). Ships eight authored starter personas. First consumer is casino.561.group; built generic for any game on the shelf. Zero runtime dependencies beyond card-table (blackjack EV).

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs src/policy/*.mjs src/personas/*.mjs src/adapters/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
